verdict.rationale: Highnote's docs describe spend rules on dollar amount and authorization count (docs-8), with velocity controls that add time-window constraints (docs-30), such as a weekly $1,000 limit (docs-9). Rules can be set at card, account, or program level and are evaluated at authorization, so the platform enforces them rather than your code (docs-18, docs-21). missing for 10: explicit documentation of daily, monthly and all-time window options (only a weekly example is shown), explicit per-cardholder (account-holder) scoping as distinct from the financial account, a concrete example of a count-based velocity rule, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
